title: Na jīrati
text: Kiṃ jīrati kiṃ na jīrati || kiṃ uppatho ti vuccati || kiṃsu dhammānaṃ paripantho || kiṃsu rattindivakkhayo || kiṃ malaṃ brahmacariyassa || kiṃ sinānam anodakaṃ || kati lokasmiṃ chiddāni || yattha cittaṃ na tiṭṭhati || bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum āgamma || katham jānemu tam mayan ti || || Rūpaṃ jīrati maccānam || nāmagottaṃ na jīrati || rāgo uppatho ti vuccati || lobho dhammānaṃ paripantho || vayo rattindivakkhayo || itthi malam brahmacariyassa || etthāyam sajjate pajā || tapo ca brahmacariyañca || tam sinānam anodakaṃ || || Cha lokasmiṃ chiddāni yattha cittaṃ na tiṭṭhati || alassañca pamādoca || anuṭṭhānaṃ asaṃyamo || niddā tandī ca te chidde || sabbaso taṃ vivajjaye ti || ||
